verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a live OpenAPI document at clerk.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), and content quoted from that file describes real API resources such as allow-lists and block-lists. That makes it a downloadable, machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: no first-party docs page that describes the spec, its scope (e.g. Backend vs Frontend API) or its versioning, and no independent community corroboration of its completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://clerk.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Allow-lists and Block-lists allow you to control who can sign up or sign in to your application
